en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small town nestled in densely forested hills. In the middle distance stands a prominent church with a tall, slender spire and adjacent buildings, surrounded by clustered houses. Coniferous trees dominate the foreground and hills, suggesting a mountainous or upland region. There is a small code or number printed in white in the lower right corner of the image.
